content:
Money in Class 3 works with rupees and paise, bills and change — practical Olympiad content. Here is what the Maths Olympiad Class 3 money chapter tests, the facts to know, the slips, and a free 10-question test.

What the Class 3 Maths Olympiad Money chapter tests

  • Rupees and paise and the ₹ rupees.paise notation
  • Converting between rupees and paise
  • Adding and subtracting money
  • Bills, totals and making change

Key facts your child should know

  • 1 rupee = 100 paise. ₹12.50 means 12 rupees 50 paise.
  • To convert ₹ to paise, multiply by 100; paise to ₹, divide by 100.
  • Line up the decimal points before adding or subtracting money.
  • Change = money given − total cost.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Misplacing the decimal point in a money sum.
  • Forgetting that 1 rupee = 100 paise when converting.
  • Adding the rupees but forgetting the paise.

quiz.title: IMO Class 3 Money Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: Rahul must pay a bill of Rs 432 using the fewest notes and coins from 500, 200, 100, 50, 20, 10, 5, 2 and 1. How many will Rahul hand over?
questions.explanation: Start with the biggest denominations: 2 × Rs 200, 1 × Rs 20, 1 × Rs 10, 1 × Rs 2. That makes 5 notes/coins.

questions.q: A shopper buys 5 toffees at Rs 6.00 each and 4 biscuits at Rs 3.25 each. What is the total bill?
Find the cost of 9 candys at Rs 5.05 each.
questions.explanation: Multiply the price by the quantity: 9 × Rs 5.05 = Rs 45.45.

questions.q: A sticker sheet costs Rs 14.35. What is its price in paise?
Kiran has 480 paise saved in a piggy bank. How much money is that in rupees?
A shopper buys 3 folders at Rs 22.50 each and 1 geometry boxs at Rs 45.50 each. What is the total bill?
A kite reel costs Rs 73.15 and a spinning top costs Rs 46.80. How much more does the kite reel cost?
questions.explanation: Rs 73.15 − Rs 46.80 = Rs 26.35, so the kite reel costs Rs 26.35 more.

questions.q: Find the cost of 8 notebooks at Rs 12.50 each.
questions.explanation: Multiply the price by the quantity: 8 × Rs 12.50 = Rs 100.00.

questions.q: A purse contains 2 Rs 200 notes, 3 Rs 50 notes, 4 Rs 2 coins. How much money is in the purse?

faq.q: How many paise are in a rupee?
faq.a: One hundred. So ₹5 = 500 paise, and 250 paise = ₹2.50.

faq.q: How do you add money amounts?
faq.a: Line up the decimal points, then add like ordinary numbers, keeping the ₹ and the two paise digits.
